import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Data input
data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03
2024-01-01,04:00,Tea,Small,5.22,1,Credit Card,18-24,1,5.22
2024-01-01,06:00,Latte,Large,6.37,2,Credit Card,45-54,1,12.74
2024-01-01,08:00,Americano,Medium,7.07,3,Cash,45-54,1,21.21"""

# Read data
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='total', hue='customer_age_group', data=df, palette='viridis')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Customer Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.legend(title='Age Group')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
